limitations: Synthetic Auth, RAM CAS and test tax observations; no hosted Supabase/Auth/PostgREST or production D1 proof
PGlite has one serialized RAM connection; no independent concurrent connections, crash durability, real multi-device latency or load claim
Recorded payments are historical entries, not ACH/Stripe/bank execution
Manual purchase tax is part of cost, not a Swiss input-VAT credit or determination of tax deductibility
No supplier orders, credit notes, attachment archive, automated extraction, inventory, fixed assets or prepaid purchase treatment in this vertical
Live tax provider remains null, USD subscription provisioning and native US distribution remain separate phases
Existing CH regression selection and unchanged source do not certify every native QR/UI/payment module
